items.title: The war will pass; AI and its ecosystem will not: 5 large-cap stocks with an upside potential of up to 33%
items.description: A war affects the mood of the market, but it does not affect every underlying business equally. There are sectors where the demand is driven by something far deeper and longer-lasting than any conflict. And those sectors carry on growing, whatever a president says, or a rebel group does.

items.title: 10 midcap stocks post highest quarterly profit in 10 quarters
items.description: Ten companies in the NSE midcap segment reported their highest quarterly net profits in the June 2026 quarter, surpassing their previous peak quarterly profits over the past 10 quarters, according to StockEdge.com’s profitability scan.The record quarterly profitability reflects the companies’ recent earnings performance and could be influenced by factors such as operational changes, cost management and market conditions. The comparison highlights companies that recorded notable improvements in quarterly net profit relative to their previous 10-quarter highs.

items.title: These 9 penny stocks plunge up to 67% in 3 months
items.description: Over the past three months, nine penny stocks have witnessed sharp corrections, with declines ranging from 42% to 67%. The stocks were identified through a screen covering companies with a market capitalisation below Rs 1,000 crore, a share price under Rs 20 and a minimum recent trading volume of 5 lakh shares. The screen highlights low-priced penny stocks with relatively higher trading activity. (Data Source: ACE Equity)

items.title: Will Nifty extend gains to 4th session on Monday? US sanctions on Russia among factors to decide D-Street action
items.description: In the latest trading session, Indian stock markets displayed contrasting trends, with Nifty climbing up while Sensex took a dip. The oil market shows signs of instability, fueled by potential supply shocks and rising prices. Geopolitical tensions in the Strait of Hormuz and US sanctions against Russia are weighing on investor sentiment. While foreign institutional investors are pulling back, local investors are stepping in to stabilize the market.

items.title: Market Trading Guide: Acme Solar, Medanta among 5 stock recommendations for Monday
items.description: Indian equities extended their recovery last week as moderation in crude and global yields improved risk appetite, despite concerns around continued geopolitical uncertainty. Investor sentiment was further supported by positive global cues following largely anticipated policy actions from major central banks. While the recent moderation in oil prices and yields provided near-term relief, analysts say the sustainability of the market recovery will depend on further easing of global macro risks and a meaningful revival in foreign investor inflows.Here are 5 stock recommendations for Monday

items.title: Rs 23,000 crore outflows! Is the September FII rout indicating a worse end to 2026?
items.description: Foreign investors have resumed selling Indian equities in September, with FPI outflows crossing Rs 23,000 crore through September 19. Higher crude prices, elevated US bond yields, geopolitical risks and currency concerns are weighing on foreign flows, while DIIs cushion the pressure.
